summary: Verified Document Branding backend API (owner + manager RBAC, persistence, sample.pdf with tenant bank details) and frontend editor flow inside AccountSettingsModal. All 6 pytest tests pass; UI flow (login owner -> profile menu -> Settings -> Document Branding nav -> edit bank_account_number -> Save -> reload -> value persists) is green. Placeholders correctly expose Pulse defaults without persisting them, and the sample PDF contains the tenant's bank number 87654321 with NO Pulse 40023205 leakage.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/document_branding.resolve_company falls back to org.get('name') or literal 'Statement' — acceptable default; consider a clearer 'Untitled Organisation' fallback so a PDF for a truly nameless org isn't titled 'Statement'.
routes/document_branding.py PUT accepts arbitrary string content with no length caps; consider a per-field maxlength (e.g. 200) to avoid oversized PDFs and DB bloat.
PUT body contract is dict without a Pydantic model — losing input validation. Fine for internal use but not ideal for a public endpoint.
Sample PDF endpoint always calls _render_invoice_pdf; a lightweight cache/rate-limit could protect against abuse since it's authenticated but any owner/manager can trigger PDF generation on demand.
seed_data_creation: Test wrote org_document_branding profile for iso-demo-org: company_name=IsoDemo Fitness Ltd, bank_account_number=99998888 (last state after UI test), payment_terms=Net 30 (mgr edit). Safe to leave or clear.
